title: Sr. Principal Engineer, MEMS Development
description:
About SiTime

SiTime is the Precision Timing company.

Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.

Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com.

Job Summary

Join the team that is revolutionizing the timing industry with the best Microelectromechanical Systems (MEMS) timing products in the world. As a Principal MEMS Development Engineer, you will use your technical and creative problem-solving skills to push forward MEMS technology and engineer resonators for SiTime’s next-generation timing products. 

Responsibilities:

  • Define and lead the development of new MEMS technologies, enhance performance or manufacturability of existing devices, improve measurement or simulation infrastructure, both through team effort and personal technical contributions
  • Lead definition and execution of challenging technical projects. 
  • Advise management of challenges, impact, recommendations.
  • Develop new or improved resonators, MEMS technologies and/or products.
  • Contribute technical ideas for SiTime’s technical roadmap, by working with Marketing and Executive teams in defining next-generation products based on new technologies. 
  • Interface with local and overseas vendors, establish new partnerships favorable to SiTime business
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Operations, and Program Management to deliver scalable, predictable development execution.
  • Adapt to evolving business needs and lead critical initiatives as required.

It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position. 

Qualifications & Requirements:  

  • Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or equivalent
  • 10+ years of industry experience in MEMS or specialty sensor development; 15+ years is preferred. Experience with MEMS timing is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success leading and delivering complex MEMS development programs.
  • Hands‑on technical credibility across MEMS design, fabrication, characterization, and modeling.
  • Strong technical and business judgment with the ability to innovate, design experiments, and interpret complex data.
  • Experience with finite element simulation tools (COMSOL, ANSYS) and data processing tools (Matlab, Python).
  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills
  • Working knowledge of programing languages, circuits, metrology equipment, and methods
  • Passion for execution excellence, ownership, delivering exceptional results

Compensation Range: 

At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success.

 

SiTime is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law.

The Principal CMOS Analog Mixed-Signal Design Engineer will be responsible for lead and supervise circuit design and chip development projects. Define device and circuit architectures for next-generation products. Design circuit blocks for future products. Review circuits and architectures to ensure high quality designs. Propose improvements and implement methodologies for IC development. It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position. 

Responsibilities:

  • Develop precision timing circuit architectures, design innovative circuits with aggressive technical performance specifications, performing transistor-level design and simulations
  • Plan and execute circuit designs that address demanding frequency stability, phase noise and power consumption, silicon die area specifications
  • Perform technology, architecture, circuit design, and parametric design trade-offs to accomplish spec-compliant designs
  • Ensure first-pass success on Analog CMOS circuit solutions, fully leveraging SiTime’s innovative MEMS technology offerings
  • Collaborate with Digital Design Engineers, CAD, Systems Engineering, ATE Engineering and Applications teams to design chips with DFT, DFM, achieve rapid silicon bring-up and fast time-to-production release
  • Deploy robust design methodology and ensure comprehensive design reviews
  • Supervise and guide Senior Analog Circuit Designers
  • Supervise Analog Circuit Physical Design Layout and edit layouts
  • Perform post-layout parasitic-extraction and back-annotated simulations to validate design across Process, Voltage, Temperature
  • Perform requisite Monte Carlo Analysis on key circuits to ensure Six-Sigma quality and yields
  • Participate in bring-up of silicon prototypes
  • Initiate Design-of Experiments for Root Cause Analysis, investigate anomalous observations in silicon across PVT conditions, and propose solutions
  • Drive other projects as needed by management or as business needs change

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • MS Degree in Electrical Engineering, PhD preferred
  • Minimum 10 years of high-performance analog circuit design experience
  • Proven track record at each stage of the following:

         1. Circuit Architecture development and technical feasibility studies

         2. Design partitioning for phase noise / power budgeting

         3. Writing detailed block-level specifications

         4. Detailed design, test bench development, and simulation of basic analog building blocks and one or more of the following:

  • ADCs, DACs, Temperature Sensors, PLL, high-speed Operational Amplifiers, On-chip Regulators, Band gap Circuits
  • Expert-level experiential knowledge of architecting and implementing ultra low-jitter, power-efficient Frac-N PLLs
  • Experiential knowledge of ultra-low phase-noise design, power supply noise considerations, device matching, parasitic extraction, signal integrity, ESD

title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend Platform
description:
NVIDIA is powering the world's most advanced AI Factories. Keeping them running depends on an Observability and Prediction platform that continuously ingests telemetry from every GPU, NIC, switch and link in the fleet - delivered both as a high-scale SaaS service and as a self-contained on-premises deployment for our largest enterprise customers.
 
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the backend platform underneath it: the distributed services that move, transform, store and serve telemetry at extreme volume, and the infrastructure that makes them deployable, upgradable and survivable on clusters ranging from a single node to tens of thousands of GPUs. This is the substrate every analytics, alerting and AI layer runs on - if it isn't fast, correct and resilient, nothing above it works.
 
What you'll be doing:
Build the high-scale data path. Design and implement the services that ingest, normalize, enrich and route enormous, continuous telemetry streams. You'll own throughput, back-pressure, concurrency, and how the system scales horizontally as clusters grow by an order of magnitude.
Design the storage and query layer. Choose the right data model and store for each kind of data, and make queries over very large datasets return fast enough to drive live dashboards, alerting and automated analysis. Own the trade-offs - cardinality, retention, cost, latency - and the APIs the rest of the product is built on.
Make it resilient. Design for partial failure: what happens when a node disappears, when state is lost, when a service restarts into the wrong configuration. Eliminate silent-failure modes where a service looks healthy while delivering nothing.
Own how the platform ships and runs. Packaging, configuration, upgrade paths, backup and restore, and clean deployment onto customer-controlled environments - so that software you can't log into still behaves correctly on day 400.
Push on performance and capacity. Profile the system under realistic load, find the real bottleneck rather than the suspected one, fix it, and translate the results into concrete sizing and scaling guidance.
 
What we need to see:
B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
5+ years of software engineering experience building production backend systems.
Strong proficiency in languages as Go, C++, Rust or Python, with solid fundamentals in concurrency, memory and performance - and the flexibility to work across languages in a polyglot codebase.
Hands-on experience with distributed systems: services that talk to each other over a network, fail independently, and have to stay correct anyway.
Practical experience with at least one class of data infrastructure - streaming/messaging systems, databases (relational, time-series, analytical, graph or key-value), or high-throughput data pipelines. We care that you understand the trade-offs, not that you've used our specific stack.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Experience shipping software that other organizations install and operate themselves: versioning, compatibility, upgrades, and debugging environments you don't control.
Depth in large-scale data systems - you've dealt with the point where the obvious design stops working and had to redesign it.
Networking or datacenter-infrastructure background, or experience with telemetry, monitoring and observability systems.
A systems thinker: you understand the full stack, from how data moves across the wire to how it's processed in a distributed cluster, and you can tell us where the time went.

title: Sr. Manager Risk & Controls
description:
The Opportunity
Adobe is seeking an experienced risk and controls leader to join the Chief Accounting Office as Senior Manager, Risk & Controls. This role offers high visibility at the crossroads of finance transformation, technology, and compliance. As the embedded risk advisor to the Finance & Tech Transformation Office (FTTO), you will collaborate directly with teams driving product launches, process automation, system implementations, and large-scale business transformation initiatives. Your focus will be ensuring that robust controls are built into solutions from the beginning, enabling innovation to move quickly without introducing compliance risks later.
You will have a meaningful role helping the organization coordinate a growing portfolio of optimization products and transformation programs. You will ensure alignment with SOX, ITAC, and ITGC requirements and support business objectives. This position works closely with internal and external auditors to maintain audit readiness, manage evidence, and lead timely remediation of control gaps across the transformation portfolio.
In this position, you can help guide Adobe’s finance operations as they scale and transform, while developing a risk and controls framework that fosters growth and innovation.
What you'll Do
Risk & Controls for Improvement Products
Partner with Process Optimization product owners to identify control risk (financial reporting, ITGC, access, data integrity) introduced by new automations, RPA bots, or process redesigns before they become available
Design and validate control frameworks for optimization products, while maintaining compliance with SOX and audit requirements
Develop and maintain a comprehensive risk register,control inventory and governance framework across the optimization product portfolio
Act as the expert authority on financial reporting risks, IT Application Controls (ITACs), and IT General Controls (ITGCs for initiatives across the CAO organization
SOX Compliance & Audit Readiness
Act as the main point of contact for SOX-IT and ITGC audit inquiries related to transformation, automation and optimization initiatives
Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, product teams, and business stakeholders to ensure controls are designed, documented, tested, and operating effectively
Coordinate updates to key financial reporting documentation, including SOX Prioritization, Risk and Control Matrix, Process Flowcharts, and Report Populations
Maintain documentation standards so that control build decisions are defensible and traceable
Build and Scale the Risk & Controls Function
Establish and grow a high-performing Risk & Controls team supporting Adobe's expanding transformation and optimization portfolio.
Define the operating model, processes, tools, and governance required to scale risk coverage as the portfolio grows.
Recruit, develop, and mentor team members, creating clear development paths and a strong culture of accountability and partnership.
Program & Collaborator Management
Manage a portfolio of risk/controls workstreams while multiple optimization and transformation activities take place.
Define and track important metrics for control health, audit findings, and remediation timelines.
Build strong relationships across Finance, Technology, Internal Audit, and Transformation teams to drive a proactive risk management mindset.
Develop and communicate knowledge through written correspondence and verbal presentations.
Document, coordinate, and close open requests from a variety of sources to ensure timely completion.
What you need to succeed
Required
7+ years in risk & controls, SOX/ITGC compliance, internal audit, or GRC program management, ideally with exposure to both finance and technology domains.
Public accounting firm experience with SOX, audit, or internal audit functions.
Direct, hands-on experience applying ITAC (IT Application Controls) and ITGC (IT General Controls) frameworks, including designing, testing, and remediating controls in live environments.
Demonstrated experience embedding controls into system implementations, RPA/automation programs, or large-scale transformation projects (not just post-facto auditing).
Deep understanding of SOX 404 requirements, audit methodology, and the full audit lifecycle including Test of Build and Test of Efficiency.
Strong collaborator management skills; able to influence without direct authority within Finance, IT, and business teams.
Prior people management experience or demonstrated readiness to build and lead a team.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Technology, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Preferred
CPA or MBA certification.
Professional certification preferred: CISA, CIA, or CPA.
Experience with GRC tooling (e.g., Archer, ServiceNow GRC, or equivalent).
Experience with automation or process/workflow platforms (e.g., UiPath, SnapLogic, Signavio, Power Automate) from a controls/risk lens.
Background in Finance Transformation, Shared Services, or Enterprise system (ERP/EPM) implementations.
High emotional intelligence coupled with proficiency in offering challenges in a nuanced, constructive manner.
Practical, hands-on approach with mentorship delivered through example.

Adobe’s Legal and Government Relations (LGR) team partners with business and functional teams to manage the company's legal and government affairs. Sub-teams within the organization include Policy, Compliance, Anti-piracy, Corporate Securities and M&A, Litigation, Intellectual Property, Privacy, Trademarks & Marketing, Employment, Real Estate, Security, Operations and Product and Sales support. Adobe’s LGR embraces groundbreaking approaches and best practices to align with Adobe’s business needs.
Against this backdrop, Adobe is seeking a Director, Corporate Legal to support key aspects of the company’s corporate legal needs, including public company securities disclosure and reporting, executive compensation, supporting Board of Directors and its committees, corporate governance, insider trading compliance, and treasury matters.
Reporting to the VP Corporate Legal, the successful candidate will be a lawyer with strategic and operational expertise in corporate and securities law,  and have strong demonstrated intellectual curiosity to develop a deep understanding of our business and products. The successful candidate will also have the ability to communicate effectively , proven success in working cross functionally, and a sharp focus on managing risk with a healthy risk appetite balance.
What You’ll Do
Work as a key member of the corporate legal team working on a broad range of U.S. securities law matters, including preparation and review of SEC filings (including Forms 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K, registration statements, proxy statements and annual reports), annual stockholder meetings, and related matters (e.g., D&O questionnaires, no-action letters)
Provide legal advice and support on corporate governance matters, including preparation and review of agenda, materials, minutes/resolutions for Adobe Inc. board and committee meetings, and reviewing and maintaining corporate governance documents, policies and guidelines.
Provide legal advice and support on executive compensation and equity-related matters, including related disclosure issues.
Provide legal support on public disclosures (e.g., earnings releases, investor relation presentations) and stockholder engagement.
Provide legal support for finance/treasury activities, including capital market transactions, credit facilities and stock buyback programs.
Support insider trading compliance and reporting, including Section 16 filings and 10b5-1 plan matters.
Provide oversight and legal guidance on subsidiary management matters, including entity maintenance, formation of new entities, restructurings and intercompany agreements
Monitor, track and advise on potential impacts of new and proposed legal and regulatory requirements with respect to securities and corporate governance matters, including related trends, benchmarking and best practices.
Develop, implement, document  and continually improve corporate and team processes and procedures, including through the use of AI tools and legal technology.
Manage and mentor a small team of corporate legal professionals, fostering a collaborative, high-performing team culture.

A JD from a leading law school/university, and at least 12 years of relevant experience at a top law firm and/or in-house legal department, specifically in public company securities reporting, corporate governance and executive compensation.
Superior relationship management skills with the ability to develop partnerships and relationships throughout the organization as well as with key external collaborators. A proven track record of building and maintaining relationships with other functional leaders and the business.
Strategic problem-solving skills with excellent legal and business judgement. Impeccable integrity and ethical behavior with a strong moral compass and a commitment to transparency.
A creative, innovative and commercial mindset with a positive attitude. Substantial experience working collaboratively and effectively with cross-functional teams.

As a Technical Account Manager, you will serve as the primary technical advisor for a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers in Mexico. You will build trusted relationships, help customers improve how they gain value from their Adobe investments, and maintain an outstanding customer experience throughout the engagement.
This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with world-class technical teams and senior leaders. It involves translating customers’ business priorities into clear technical strategies, operational plans, and measurable outcomes. You will proactively identify risks, uncover optimization opportunities, and orchestrate the appropriate Adobe resources to help customers achieve their long-term goals.
Responsibilities
Serve as the primary technical advisor and point of coordination for a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers
Build and maintain trusted relationships with practitioners, technical leaders, managers, directors, and C-level executives
Translate complex business objectives into actionable technical strategies, success plans, and operational priorities
Proactively identify customer needs, technical risks, and opportunities for optimization, adoption, and long-term improvement
Orchestrate the resolution of complex technical issues by coordinating across Adobe Engineering, TechOps, Managed Services, Support, Product, and other internal teams
Establish clear expectations and maintain consistent communication through regular checkpoints, status reviews, governance meetings, and planning sessions.
Conduct in-depth assessments of customers’ technical environments to identify architectural risks, performance concerns, integration challenges, and opportunities for improvement
Provide strategic advice on implementation approaches, technical guidelines, scalability, performance, integrations, and operational readiness
Co-lead Quarterly Business Reviews, executive briefings, and technical presentations, connecting the realities of the customer’s technical environment with business priorities and measurable outcomes
Maintain structured oversight of open actions, technical dependencies, risks, and critical issues, ensuring clear ownership and timely follow-through
Advocate for customers within Adobe while balancing their priorities with technical feasibility, product capabilities, and internal commitments
Collaborate across Adobe teams to deliver a coordinated and consistent customer experience

Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field, or equivalent professional experience
Seven or more years of experience in Technical Account Management, technical consulting, solution architecture, or another senior customer-facing technical role
Demonstrated success managing complex enterprise customer relationships in a consultative capacity
Good understanding of marketing technology, advertising technology, and AI-powered solutions, including their application within complex enterprise environments
Strong knowledge of web technologies, including JavaScript, jQuery, Java, HTML/HTML5, CSS, REST APIs, and database technologies
Solid understanding of tag management, digital data collection, and enterprise implementation methodologies
Experience solving issues, performance-tuning, and optimizing web/app environments
Ability to read and interpret code, fix technical implementations, and understand third-party integrations at the API level
Familiarity with Agile and Scrum development methodologies
Strong executive presence, with the ability to communicate effectively with and influence senior technical and business leaders
Ability to develop and deliver clear, compelling executive presentations
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Spanish and English
Strong emotional intelligence, active listening skills, and the ability to navigate complex or sensitive customer conversations

Strong ownership and follow-through, supported by a structured approach to tracking, prioritizing, and closing complex technical and business actions
Excellent organization, prioritization, and time-management skills
Willingness to travel approximately 15–20% of the time and availability for recurring onsite work at both Adobe offices and customer locations

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Enterprise Architect
Position Summary
As an Enterprise Architect at Adobe, you will build the future of digital experiences by helping global organizations unlock the full potential of data, AI, and cloud technologies. You will collaborate with executive leaders to develop transformation strategies, compose enterprise architecture roadmaps, and deliver innovative solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
In this highly visible role, you will serve as a trusted advisor, guiding clients through complex digital, data, and AI transformations. You will build scalable, secure, and future-ready architectures that connect customer data, intelligence, content, and activation across Adobe Experience Cloud and modern cloud ecosystems.
You will influence strategic decisions, bring collaborators together around a shared vision, and help organizations accelerate innovation while delivering outstanding customer experiences.
Success in this role is measured by the value you build for customers. It also depends on the quality and impact of your architectural leadership. Additionally, success includes the adoption of recommended solutions and the positive relationships you develop with executives and delivery teams.
The Opportunity
Organizations are reimagining how they engage customers in an increasingly digital and technology-driven world. Adobe is at the forefront of this transformation, helping businesses build personalized, connected, and intelligent experiences at scale.
As a member of Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture group, you will:
Work alongside executives to establish approaches for digital experience, customer data, and AI transformation.
Build enterprise architectures that connect content, data, insights, and activation across the customer journey.
Assist organizations in embracing cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven architectures through Adobe Experience Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, and major public cloud providers.
Enable clients to accelerate innovation while reducing complexity and enhancing business value.
This is an opportunity to influence enterprise-scale transformation initiatives, build technology strategy, and help clients achieve lasting competitive advantage.
What You Will Do
Develop Digital, Data, and AI Strategy
Collaborate with executive and senior partners to establish a clear vision for digital experiences, customer engagement, and AI-powered innovation.
Translate business priorities into actionable, multi-year architecture roadmaps that align technology investments with strategic outcomes.
See opportunities to improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and business performance by using data, AI, and personalization.
Define success measures, value hypotheses, and benchmarks that guide investment decisions and demonstrate impact.
Lead Enterprise Architecture Build
Build scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and client technology ecosystems.
Define modern data and AI architecture patterns, including customer data platforms, identity management, real-time decisioning, and personalization.
Establish architecture standards and guidelines for cloud-native, API-first, event-driven, and microservices-based solutions.
Develop reference architectures that enable agility, governance, security, and long-term scalability.
Ensure architecture decisions support reliability, observability, performance, and business continuity.
Drive Alignment and Transformation
Align business strategy, enterprise architecture, and delivery execution across marketing, technology, product, analytics, and data teams.
Establish governance frameworks, operating models, and decision-making processes that enable balanced adoption and continuous improvement.
Build positive relationships across client organizations, Adobe teams, and external partners to accelerate successful outcomes.
Guide organizations through technology change while managing complexity and reducing risk.
Influence and Encourage
Communicate architecture vision, trade-offs, and recommendations with clarity and confidence to executive audiences.
Lead strategy workshops, architecture reviews, and roadmap discussions that align collaborators and build momentum for transformation.
Advocate for data-driven and AI-powered experiences that build measurable value for customers and businesses.
Serve as a leader with a point of view who helps clients navigate new technologies and evolving market trends.
Contribute to Adobe's Growth
Build reusable frameworks, reference architectures, accelerators, and guidelines that strengthen Adobe's consulting capabilities.
Mentor architects and consultants, encouraging a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
Support strategic sales opportunities through solution building, executive presentations, and proposal development.
Contribute to the evolution of Adobe's Enterprise Architecture practice and help build its strategic direction.
What You Need to Succeed
Required Qualifications
Proven success developing and leading enterprise architecture strategies for complex organizations.
Deep expertise with enterprise architecture frameworks and integration patterns, including TOGAF, API-first, and architectures built on connecting different services.
Experience crafting and delivering cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or comparable cloud platforms.
Demonstrated experience crafting AI-enabled customer experiences and applying concepts such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and model evaluation.
Understanding of AI governance, agentic architectures, observability, reliability, and responsible AI practices in enterprise environments.
Ability to translate business objectives into scalable technology strategies and architecture roadmaps.
Strong executive communication and collaborator management skills, with the ability to influence decision-making across organizations.
Experience collaborating with software engineers, data architects, application developers, data scientists, and business leaders to deliver end-to-end solutions.
Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Ability to lead through influence and drive alignment across diverse teams and functions.
Willingness to travel up to 50%.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with Adobe Experience Cloud and Adobe Experience Platform tools.
Experience working with digital marketing, customer experience, customer data, or personalization platforms.
Knowledge of customer journey orchestration, decisioning, and real-time activation strategies.
Experience leading enterprise-scale digital transformation initiatives.

title: Staff Security Data Engineer
description:
About the role
Adobe’s Security Data Platform team builds and operates a petabyte-scale security data lakehouse that turns enterprise telemetry into trusted data for threat detection, investigations, compliance, and security analytics.
 
As a Staff Security Data Engineer, you will own full-system designs and lead critical engineering initiatives across ingestion, storage, governance, orchestration, and data serving. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you will write and review production code, build infrastructure, define test strategy, fix complex failures, and work with other engineers to deliver the architecture you help shape.
 
You will partner with Security Operations, Threat Intelligence, Compliance, Security Engineering, and infrastructure teams to resolve technical tradeoffs and deliver reliable, cost-effective platform capabilities. Your impact will come through engineering delivery, sound architectural decisions, and helping others become stronger technical leaders.
 
Help us evolve our team from petabyte scale toward exabyte scale!
 
Core responsibilities
Platform architecture and engineering
Own end-to-end designs that shape the Security Data Platform’s fundamental architecture on Databricks and AWS, using Spark, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog. Translate ambiguous needs into design proposals, implementation plans, and production capabilities.
Build and evolve distributed batch and streaming pipelines for EDR telemetry, network logs, identity events, cloud audit logs, and new security data sources. Design for throughput, fault tolerance, replay, schema evolution, and sub-minute freshness where use cases require it.
Write maintainable Python and SQL, develop complex platform features, and refactor unreliable code. Establish reusable engineering patterns, lead code and design reviews, and own test strategy and automation choices across pipelines and infrastructure.
Build and maintain tested, reusable Terraform modules for AWS and Databricks infrastructure, including S3, IAM, VPC networking, and Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (MWAA). Automate delivery through version control and CI/CD.
Data modeling governance and operations
Design layered lakehouse data models and reusable normalization patterns, including Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework (OCSF) mappings where appropriate. Preserve source fidelity and make datasets useful for investigations, analytics, and detection workloads.
Establish data contracts, quality checks, cataloging, classification, lineage, access controls, and retention policies with data owners. Use Unity Catalog to make data ownership and governance traceable from raw events to analyst-facing datasets.
Engineer and operate Airflow and MWAA orchestration, including dependencies, retries, backfills, alerting, and automated recovery. Define service level objectives with consumers and instrument data freshness, completeness, pipeline health, and query performance.
Lead diagnosis and resolution of complex production issues across Spark, storage, orchestration, and cloud infrastructure. Improve incident response, runbooks, recovery testing, and operational readiness to prevent recurring failures.
Performance and technical leadership
Profile workloads and lead measurable cost and performance improvements through query and Spark tuning, storage lifecycle policies, partitioning, and compute right-sizing. Establish baselines and dashboards that show savings alongside reliability, latency, and capacity.
Lead cross-team technical discussions, reconcile competing requirements, and build agreement on architecture and delivery priorities without formal management authority. Communicate decisions, landmarks, risks, and business impact proactively to your manager and partners.
Partner with detection and security analytics engineers to deliver the data interfaces, governance, and pipeline capabilities needed for SIEM modernization and automated detection deployment.
Mentor engineers through pairing, technical reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Help others lead technical work, promote inclusive debate, and contribute to hiring decisions through technical assessment.
Evaluate and introduce useful platform innovations, including AI-assisted engineering and operational automation. Validate outputs, protect sensitive security data, measure improvements, and help partner teams adopt proven approaches.
 
Required qualifications
Substantial experience building and operating production data platforms, typically 10 or more years in data or software engineering, with demonstrated Staff-level scope and impact. Equivalent depth and outcomes are welcome; a prior Staff or Principal title is not required.
A record of personally delivering complex distributed systems and leading full-system design and implementation across team boundaries. Ability to turn general, unstructured assignments into clear technical approaches and working software.
Deep production expertise in Spark's traditional and real-time data workloads, Databricks, Delta Lake, and lakehouse architecture; strong Python and advanced SQL skills for data modeling, profiling, and query optimization.  
Strong AWS experience across storage, compute, networking, and IAM, plus production Terraform experience designing, testing, and maintaining reusable infrastructure modules.
Practical understanding of distributed systems, including partitioning, replication, consistency, back pressure, scalability, and fault tolerance, with experience diagnosing failures across system boundaries.
Experience with Airflow, MWAA, or equivalent orchestration, and with production observability, data quality, automated testing, CI/CD, and reliable deployment and recovery practices.
Demonstrated ability to improve platform cost, performance, and reliability with measurable results; sound judgment in balancing these goals against security and consumer requirements.
Effective technical communication and multi-functional influence, including leading design reviews, resolving disagreements, mentoring engineers, and building adoption of shared engineering practices.
 
Preferred qualifications
Experience with security telemetry, OCSF or comparable security schemas, and data requirements for SIEM, SOAR, threat detection, or investigations.
Experience with Unity Catalog governance, data classification and retention, regional data controls, or multi-region platform design.
Experience with Cribl Stream, Vector, or similar telemetry routing and enrichment tools, and platform integrations supporting automated threat detection rollout.

title: Senior Manager, Employee Relations
description:
The Opportunity 
Adobe is seeking a Senior Manager, Employee Relations, to join the Americas Employee & Labor Relations (ELR) leadership team.
This San Jose based role will lead a team of Employee Relations professionals supporting a large and diverse business portfolio. Beyond portfolio leadership, it also serves as a strategic leader within the broader ELR function. It combines outstanding people leadership and deep employee relations expertise to shape enterprise wide priorities, improve organizational capability, and drive initiatives that impact how ELR supports employees, managers, and the business.
We're looking for someone who loves Employee Relations and is energized by developing others. They bring strong judgment, curiosity, and the confidence to offer new ideas, challenge thinking, and influence outcomes.
What You'll Do
Build and Lead a High-Impact ER Team
Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing Employee Relations team known for exceptional consultation, sound judgment, and meaningful business impact.
Build a strong leadership bench through coaching, development, and meaningful opportunities that expand capability, exposure, and career growth.
Set high standards and accountability while strengthening capability across ELR through coaching, calibration, and shared learning.
Set Strategy and Lead Through Complexity
Define and implement the ER strategy for a large, complex business portfolio, aligning priorities to enterprise strategy, workforce trends, and emerging risk.
Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior business and HR leaders.
Guide critical workforce decisions and complex employee matters with significant business, employee, legal, or reputational implications.
Turn data, trends, and employee insights into actions that address risk, identify systemic opportunities, and improve business outcomes.
Shape and Deliver the Global ELR Agenda
Sponsor and lead Americas and global initiatives that strengthen Employee Relations, promotes shared learning, and advances the function.
Partner across regions to develop scalable programs, practices, and solutions which balance global consistency with local requirements and strengthen the collective capability of global ELR.
Lead high-visibility, cross-functional work from strategy through implementation and adoption.
Leverage AI, automation, data, and innovative technologies to transform ELR delivery, generate insights, and create more capacity for coaching, consultation, and complex problem-solving, while establishing and promoting responsible AI practices that preserve privacy, fairness, and human judgment.
What You Need to Succeed
Significant experience leading Employee Relations teams in a sizable, multifaceted organization, developing talent and building high-performing teams.
Deep Employee Relations expertise across performance, conduct, conflict resolution, workplace concerns, and organizational change.
Experience shaping ER strategy for complex business portfolios and influencing high-impact workforce decisions.
Proven ability to advise senior leaders and navigate sensitive, high-stakes employee matters with sound judgment.
Experience leading complex initiatives across business groups, functions, regions, or geographies.
Ability to identify patterns, risks, and opportunities across and translate insights into meaningful action.
Interest in the responsible application of AI and emerging technologies to enhance Employee Relations.
A genuine passion for Employee Relations, developing people, and building what comes next.

title: Senior Digital Strategist
description:
About the Role
As an 
Digital Strategist
, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the successful adoption of marketing technology platforms by increasing employee engagement, streamlining operational models, and driving sustainable change. You'll work with Adobe’s largest enterprise customers, guiding them through digital marketing transformation across technology, business processes, organizational structures, and workforce capabilities.
This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and hands-on experience with organizational change. You’ll help customers navigate the complexities of onboarding and adopting new digital solutions—ensuring they unlock the full potential of their investments.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Change Leadership
Lead digital transformation engagements focused on change management, operating model refinement, and organizational design.
Partner with executive stakeholders to align digital strategy with business goals.
Facilitate discovery sessions and strategic workshops to uncover needs and co-create solutions.
Deliver compelling executive-level presentations, strategic roadmaps, and value frameworks.
Change Management Execution
Apply structured change management methodologies (e.g., Prosci) to drive adoption.
Create actionable deliverables for change levers: communication plans, sponsor roadmaps, training and coaching programs, and resistance management.
Assess change readiness, conduct impact analyses, and develop stakeholder engagement plans.
Support project teams in integrating change activities into delivery plans.
Organizational Enablement
Define and implement future-state operating models, team structures, and process frameworks.
Coach senior leaders and managers to act as effective change sponsors.
Support the development and delivery of training programs to drive user adoption.
Practice Development
Contribute to the evolution of the Digital Strategy & Performance practice.
Share knowledge, mentor team members, and support methodology development.
Collaborate closely with Adobe’s delivery and partner teams to ensure seamless execution.
Required Skills & Qualifications
10+ years
 of experience in digital strategy, marketing technology, or business transformation.
Proven success leading large-scale change and adoption programs.
Strong executive presence and communication skills—verbal, written, and visual.
Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud or similar platforms (Salesforce, Oracle, etc.).
Deep understanding of digital marketing strategy and marketing operations.
Background in one or more key industries (e.g., retail, finance, travel, media).
Hands-on experience in creating and delivering value-driven business cases.
Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, and stakeholder management capabilities.

Change Management:
Prosci Change Management Certification

Familiarity with project management tools, phases, and methodologies

Naturally collaborative and comfortable working in cross-functional environments.

Passion for helping clients achieve measurable business value through transformation.

title: Head of Government Relations & Public Policy, UKI and Middle East
job_title: Head of Government Relations & Public Policy, UKI and Middle East
description:
The Opportunity 
Adobe seeks a leader to join our Global Government Relations and Public Policy team to advance our efforts in the UK, located in London. This leader will also support Adobe’s policy involvement in Ireland and the Middle East.
The team fosters a vibrant and enjoyable work atmosphere with outstanding opportunities to interact directly with governmental organisations, formulate policy positions, and assist Adobe’s operations. This role includes working alongside senior leaders, advising them, and designing engagement plans when appropriate. The position will report to the EMEA Director based in Germany.
We are seeking a creative and well-networked government relations professional who demonstrates initiative. The ideal candidate will possess comprehensive knowledge of digital policies in the UK as well as technology procurement policy procedures. This position demands outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, enthusiasm, and a keen interest in technology policies, government IT modernisation, and the customer experience field.
What you will do 
Development, coordination, and implementation of a successful government relations engagement strategy, including engagement planning for senior leaders.
Take ownership of Adobe's engagement with UK regulatory authorities on sensitive, active matters, working closely with Legal and senior collaborators and managing confidential communications.
Advocate for policy changes that are good for our employees, customers, and business generally.
Handle resources to accomplish the goals of the organisation including outside consultants and trade associations.
Work autonomously and engage with senior leadership to drive impact.
Ensure Adobe is well positioned and follows all relevant regulations and requirements.
Develop and advocate for external policy positions which improve Adobe’s position in the marketplace.
Develop monitoring and reporting processes to ensure policies and issues that impact Adobe are flagged and mitigated where possible.
Responsibility for delivering successful outcomes and maintaining high levels of internal and external partner happiness.
Assist Adobe’s local teams based in the UK in every aspect of their work.
Aid Adobe's local groups in the Middle East (with emphasis on KSA and UAE) whenever needed; this is not encouraged to be the main allocation of time.
Build on and deepen relationships with policy experts, internal teams, trade association personnel, and government decision-makers.
Align with Adobe's Global Public Policy team on overarching narratives and positions, tailoring messaging and engagement approach to fit the specific dynamics of the UK market.
Drive Adobe’s Government Relations involvement in public sector sales/procurement activities in UK/I & Middle East.
Promote procurement and digital government policies that advance the customer experience and the digital service delivery provided by government.
What you will need
15+ years of confirmed experience in successful government engagement
Comprehensive, direct experience with government policies and procedures in the UK
Experience engaging with government or regulatory bodies on a sensitive, high-stakes matter requiring discretion and confidentiality
Direct knowledge of political structures and functions, and sound understanding of how to appropriately engage with political and external policy development bodies and parties
Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to translate complicated technical concepts into a compelling, succinct case for political outreach
Strong self-starter, comfortable working autonomously while building consensus and collaboration with top executives internally
Capability to guide through influence rather than official power: forming alliances and attaining outcomes with internal and external partners who are not your direct reports. You will think and act both strategically and creatively.
Dedication to quick results balanced with the vision to see how long-term strategies need to unfold
Genuine passion for the positive role government can play in society, and a strong desire to help improve it
Curiosity and adaptability to grow alongside Adobe's expanding business as it accelerates
Knowledge of policy dynamics in the Gulf region (KSA/UAE) and Arabic language skills are a plus, but not required
High command of English and preferably another European language

description:
The Opportunity 
Join our team at Adobe, where creativity and innovation blend with collaboration, and legal minds lead the way in shaping the future. Seeking a Legal Counsel who is sharp, savvy, and prepared to excel in our dynamic team.
We are looking for a Commercial/IT/IP lawyer with 6+ years of PQE, dedicated to making a meaningful difference, and prepared to take on a pivotal position in our operations within the Northern Region (UK, Ireland, Middle East, and Africa).
About the team
A Legal Team Like No Other: Supportive, encouraging, and above all friendly. We lift each other up, share knowledge freely, and always find time to celebrate wins (big or small).
Diversity & Inclusion: We champion every voice, celebrate every background, and believe that brilliant ideas come from everywhere.
Work/Life Balance: We know life is more than work. Flexible schedules and hybrid options are here to keep you energised.
Growth & Opportunity: Adobe is rapidly growing, and so, can you. Get involved in crafting new systems (think: AI chatbots, CLM, knowledge sharing, automation) and work processes.
What you will do 
Become a key consultant for our dynamic sales team, working with sales, marketing, finance, and other teams. Your knowledge will drive our Northern Region business, particularly in the Middle East where Adobe established a new headquarters in Riyadh.
Draft, Review & Negotiate: Take the lead on a variety of agreements, licensing, professional services, consulting, statements of work, resale, distribution, sales. You’ll keep us covered and keep deals moving.
Commercial Legal Support: Partner with our business units, providing timely, commercial advice and delivering in-house training on the legal topics that matter most. Help demystify law for your colleagues!
Compliance Monitor: Be proactive in tracking and offering recommendations on the newest regulations and laws that affect Adobe, with a focus on technology, AI, intellectual property, and data privacy/ security.
Drive Process Improvement: Dive into knowledge management and help evolve our legal processes. Lead departmental projects that make us better, smarter, and faster.
Project Legal Support: Join working groups as new projects and business practices are developed, bringing your legal and business perspective where it’s needed most.
Ongoing Training & Risk Management: Carry out internal training sessions, and offer continuous support on key risks, building a culture of compliance and confidence.

Qualified Lawyer: You’ve trained and qualified with a reputable law firm or an in-house department of a comparable company, with at least 6 years PQE.
Commercial/IT/IP Experience: You possess a demonstrated history in these domains, and you grasp the complexities of software, technology, and data protection concerns.
Business and Risk Savvy: You see the bigger picture and understand how legal matters fit into business objectives, assess, and manage risks across multiple matters at once.
Communication Ace: Your drafting and technical skills are outstanding, and you can translate complex legalese into everyday plain language.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Risk Platform (ARP) team. ARP is Adobe's centralized, adaptive system for detecting, preventing, and mitigating fraud and abuse across products and services — protecting surfaces like Commerce, Stock, and Firefly with real-time risk decisions, without degrading the customer experience.
In this position, you will help build and develop machine learning models to identify fraudulent activity, detect abusive account behavior, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. You'll work across the model lifecycle from raw behavioral data and feature engineering, to model training, deployment, and monitoring alongside senior engineers on the team.
Key Responsibilities
Help build and train ML models covering various fraud and abuse areas. These include financial transaction fraud, device-related deception, and account and identity abuse. The goal is a unified, continuously-updated trust and risk score.
Contribute to feature engineering across transaction, device, and behavioral event data.
Build and maintain feature pipelines on Databricks and Spark, transforming raw transaction and device event data into high-quality model inputs.
Help translate prototypes into production ML systems, working with senior engineers on scalability, reliability, and observability.
Support MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, and production monitoring.
Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, product, and platform teams to understand fraud and abuse patterns across Adobe's surfaces.
Stay ahead of advances in ML/AI, particularly in fraud detection and behavioral modeling, and bring relevant ideas to the team.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
3+ years of professional experience building and deploying ML solutions, or equivalent experience through internships, research, or personal projects.
Solid programming skills in Python, with hands-on experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or similar frameworks.
Working understanding of the ML lifecycle — from data collection through deployment and monitoring.
Eagerness to learn model optimization, inference efficiency, and production system integration, with support from senior engineers on the team.
Preferred Qualifications
Coursework, projects, or professional experience in any of: payment fraud, device fingerprinting, account takeover detection, anomaly detection, or graph-based modeling.
Exposure to sequence modeling, transformer architectures, or graph neural networks.
Familiarity with Databricks, Spark, or large-scale transactional/event pipelines.

As a Senior Program Manager focused on the Operational Workforce Planning Capability, you will play a critical role in enabling Autodesk to effectively operationalize its workforce plans and ensure the right people are in the right roles at the right time. You will be responsible for driving process excellence, coordinating cross-functional execution, and ensuring consistent, data-driven workforce planning practices across the organization. Position Overview
We are looking for a Senior Technical Support Specialist with strong experience in plastic injection molding and simulation to help customers solve complex engineering challenges using Autodesk Moldflow.
In this role, you will combine technical expertise, problem-solving, and strong communication skills to troubleshoot simulation and manufacturing issues, interpret results, and help customers get the most value from Autodesk products. You will also contribute to the future of technical support by using emerging AI, automation, and connected Autodesk workflows across Moldflow, Fusion, and related technologies.
Responsibilities
Provide expert technical support for Autodesk Moldflow customers.
Diagnose and resolve issues involving geometry, meshing, materials, process settings, solver behavior, and simulation results.
Help customers distinguish between software issues, modeling assumptions, and real-world molding or manufacturing challenges.
Research, reproduce, and document product issues and collaborate with Product Development and Engineering teams as needed.
Create clear technical articles, troubleshooting guidance, and reusable knowledge for customers and internal teams.
Use AI-assisted tools to improve troubleshooting, research, and knowledge creation while validating technical accuracy with sound engineering judgment.
Develop expertise in connected Autodesk workflows, including Moldflow, Fusion, and related design and manufacturing technologies.
Minimum Qualifications
3-5+ years of experience with plastic injection-molding simulation, preferably Autodesk Moldflow, or equivalent injection-molding industry experience.
Bachelor’s degree in Plastics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of injection molding, polymer behavior, processing conditions, and manufacturing fundamentals.
Experience preparing, running, troubleshooting, and interpreting engineering simulations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated customer focus and ownership of technical problems through resolution.
Ability to learn quickly and thrive in a fast-changing technical environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Advanced experience with Autodesk Moldflow Insight
Practical experience in injection molding, mold design, tooling, process engineering, or plastics manufacturing.
Familiarity with Autodesk Fusion, Inventor, or other CAD/CAE platforms.
Experience with CFD, FEA, thermal, or multiphysics simulation.
Experience with Python, scripting, APIs, automation, or engineering productivity tools.
Experience using AI-assisted tools for engineering, technical research, troubleshooting, or workflow automation.
The Ideal Candidate
You are a technically curious problem solver who enjoys helping others succeed. You can explain complex engineering concepts clearly, take ownership of difficult customer issues, and use data and engineering fundamentals to reach sound conclusions.

Position Overview 
Autodesk is strengthening its M&A HR capability to support disciplined growth, speed to integrate, and positive employee experience through change. The M&A Total Rewards Partner plays a critical role in supporting Total Rewards activities across the deal lifecycle, from diligence through close and post-close integration, by helping evaluate, advise on, and execute compensation and rewards decisions.
 
This trusted M&A TR advisor partners closely with Corporate Development, Finance, Legal, People Business Partners (PBPs), and People & Places leadership to assess workforce impacts, identify people related risks, and support informed, market aligned rewards decisions. You translate fast-moving and ambiguous deal inputs into clear, pragmatic recommendations that balance internal equity, external market competitiveness, cost, and employee experience.
 
Responsibilities
Deal Lifecycle Support
·       Support end-to-end Total Rewards activities across M&A transactions, including due diligence, integration planning, deal modeling, close execution, and post-close integration
·       Evaluate target company compensation structures, incentive plans, equity programs, and benefits positioning to identify risks, gaps, and integration considerations
·       Partner with Finance and Corporate Development to support cost modeling, synergy assumptions, and people related deal risks
·       Support communications and enablement related to compensation, benefits, retention programs, and other Total Rewards changes throughout the transaction lifecycle
 
Total Rewards & Market Analysis
·       Conduct job and level mapping using Autodesk job architecture and market data
·       Analyze internal and external market positioning to inform pay alignment, equity conversion, and retention recommendations
·       Develop compensation, equity, and retention recommendations for executives and key talent populations where retention or leadership continuity is critical
·       Assess target company benefits, identify gaps vs. company programs, and execute compliant, cost-effective transition and harmonization plans
·       Support the design of transition, retention, and harmonization approaches consistent with Autodesk Total Rewards principles
 
Advisory & Stakeholder Partnership
·       Partner with PBPs, Legal, and business leaders to surface implications, tradeoffs, and recommended paths forward
·       Prepare clear, decision-ready materials that summarize options, risks, and financial impact for leadership review
·       Apply established governance and approval frameworks consistently across transactions
 
Execution & Integration

·       Support cross-functional planning and coordination to ensure Total Rewards deliverables, dependencies, and milestones remain on track throughout the transaction lifecycle
·       Coordinate closely with HR Operations, Payroll, and related teams to ensure accurate and timely implementation
·       Contribute to continuous improvement of M&A Total Rewards playbooks, tools, and templates based on deal learnings

Support Executive Compensation activities, including equity modeling and forecasting, peer group proxy data analysis, and preparation of Compensation Committee materials

title: Graduate Software Engineer
description:
Job Requisition ID #
26WD100002
Join Autodesk in Oslo as a Graduate Software Engineer in August 2027
Position Overview 
 
At Autodesk Oslo, we develop next-generation, AI-powered architecture design tools. Our teams build everything from advanced 3D web drawing to real-time analytics powering multiple Autodesk products. You'll help shape the Forma Industry Cloud for the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry.
About us 
We're on a mission to help design better cities. With 90% of future population growth expected in cities and construction responsible for 40% of global CO₂ emissions, the AEC industry must evolve. We're building a new generation of cloud-based software that helps architects, urban planners, and real estate developers design sites and buildings in a new way. Our Forma Design applications focus on outcome-based design, helping users weigh living quality (sun, daylight potential, noise, etc.), environmental impact (embodied and operational carbon), and profitability so they can find smarter, more sustainable solutions for their projects.
How we work 
We're a fundamentally agile organization, built on empowered teams that have the freedom to innovate at speed while staying aligned. We believe in servant leadership and team accountability, so teams are trusted to find the best way to develop their solutions, with a bottom-up approach to decision-making. Engineers, product managers, and designers work side by side, collaborating across functions and time zones. We're an agentic-first organization, so working alongside AI tooling is part of how every team operates.
Responsibilities 
From day one, you'll deliver real value as part of an empowered product team. You won't be on the sidelines: you'll own features end to end, help shape what gets built, and see your work reach customers around the world.
As a Graduate Software Engineer, you'll:
- Build, test, and ship features used by architects, urban planners, and real estate developers worldwide
- Take ownership of your work, from idea and design through to release and iteration
- Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to solve real customer problems
- Take part in code reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making
- Continuously learn, experiment, and improve how we build software
Learning and growth 
We invest in your growth from the start. At Autodesk, learning is part of the job: you'll work alongside experienced engineers, designers, and product managers, contributing to real products while building your skills in a supportive environment. You'll also build the habit of working effectively with AI-powered tools as part of your daily workflow.
As a graduate, you'll have opportunities to connect with the wider Autodesk community through events such as Autodesk University (AU), TechX, internal meetups, workshops, and hackathons, as well as external conferences, bringing new ideas and perspectives back to your team.
Minimum Qualifications
- Eager to learn and thrive in an autonomous, high-agency culture
- Collaborative and open to sharing knowledge Experience with coding (coursework or internships)
- Comfortable solving complex problems and breaking them down
- Able to work in a fast-paced environment, balancing innovation with code quality
- Motivated by our mission to design better, more sustainable cities
For us to review your application, you must upload your CV, relevant diplomas/certificates, and academic transcripts in PDF format.
Even if you feel you don't check off all the items on the list, we still encourage you to apply. Kindly note that applications must include a cover letter and a CV to be considered.

title: Software Engineering manager
description:
Job Requisition ID #
26WD100721
Engineering Manager
Help shape how cities are designed
 
We are looking for an Engineering Manager to grow and develop talent across our organization in our AI-powered architecture design platform. You will spend roughly 70% of your time on product development and 30% on people leadership, managing career growth, removing blockers, and developing individual contributors. You will be working with a group of engineering managers, focusing on the health and growth of our people.
As an Engineering Manager you will be the people leader for a group of individual contributors who work on different product teams. You will combine hands-on technical judgment with thoughtful people leadership. You will mentor engineers in their growth, set quality and technical standards, and remove blockers so your engineers can do their best work. You will work alongside your people on systems that combine cloud architecture, performance-sensitive applications, and AI to support complex design and simulation workflows.
Your work will enable architects, planners, and developers to discover smarter, more sustainable solutions and gain meaningful insights into their projects.
About us
We are on a mission to help design better cities.
With 90% of future population growth expected in urban areas, and construction responsible for around 40% of global CO₂ emissions, the AEC industry must evolve. Our cloud-based Autodesk Forma platform helps users evaluate design choices based on environmental impact, living quality (sun, daylight, noise), and project feasibility. We started as Spacemaker in Norway and became part of Autodesk in 2020.
 
Learn more about Autodesk Forma here.
How we work
We work in a matrix organization with high degrees of trust and autonomy. We strongly believe in servant leadership and shared accountability. Engineering managers work as peers in a leadership team while managing individual contributors across product teams. Each engineer has both product-team relationships and a manager relationship. To learn more about our way of
working, read through our 
tech
 and 
product core beliefs.
Responsibilities
As an Engineering Manager, you will develop engineers across the organization while remaining a strong hands-on contributor. You will split your time between people leadership and product development.
People leadership
Own career development and growth for your engineers. Understand each engineer's strengths, development areas, and aspirations
Conduct regular one-on-ones, feedback cycles, and coaching conversations
Participate in hiring and onboarding of engineers. Ensure smooth integration into the organization and their product teams
Remove blockers and advocate for your engineers to ensure they have what they need to succeed
Work with product leads and peer managers to support team health and development
Hans-On engineering
Contribute by coding and being a member of the team
Partner with your engineers on technical problems and decisions
Model high standards for code quality, communication, and problem-solving
Work through technical trade-offs alongside your engineers, contributing your own perspective as a peer contributor
Desired profile
Combines strong technical judgment with genuine interest in growing people
Operates with clarity in ambiguous situations and is comfortable handling competing priorities
Recognized as a skilled engineer who writes and ships code regularly
Brings others along through mentoring, enabling, and fostering growth
Experience managing individual contributors across multiple contexts or product areas
Collaborates effectively with peers, product leads, and across the organization
Comfortable developing engineers who work in different teams and on different projects
Motivated by our mission and focused on delivering meaningful impact at scale
Where you might see yourself
Your own hands-on engineering background likely looks like one of the following
You get your energy from building the foundations other people rely on, pulling systems apart into simple, observable pieces, owning something in production long enough to feel responsible for it, and reaching for the boring, reliable option before building something new.
You're drawn to problems where the math is the hard part, geometry, simulation, optimization, and you like taking a model from "this is the theory" to something that runs reliably on real inputs and matches what users expect to see.
You start from the user and the problem, not the ticket. You are comfortable with a fuzzy brief and a blank repo, shipping fast to learn, and shaping what gets built as much as how it gets built.
What will help you suceed in this role
Strong hands-on engineering background building cloud-based, user-facing systems
Experience in an engineering manager, team lead, or similar people-leadership role
Genuine interest in developing people and creating environments where they grow
Comfort with matrix or dotted-line structures where you manage people who work across different teams
Proven ability to balance hands-on technical contribution with people leadership
Strong communication skills, especially in one-on-one coaching and feedback conversations
Experience with Agentic AI
You might also bring
Experience with TypeScript, serverless architectures and AWS
Background in large-scale systems or platform development
Experience working in cross-functional, international product teams
Track record of mentoring and developing engineers into stronger contributors
Experience with 3D graphics, WebGL/WebGPU, or real-time rendering in the browser
Experience with computational geometry, spatial algorithms, or CAD/BIM data models
Why join us
Develop engineers across the organization while staying technical. Roughly 70% of your time spent on hands-on product development
Build and grow a talented group of engineers. See them succeed and advance in their careers
Influence the organization through people leadership and technical mentorship
Direct impact on real-world problems with measurable environmental impact
Work with experienced engineers across the organization in a mission-driven culture
Competitive compensation, pension, and benefits
We believe diverse teams build better products, and we are committed to creating a workplace where people can be themselves and do their best work. We encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every requirement listed. Curiosity, empathy, and a growth mindset matter just as much to us.

title: Principal Program Manager, Business Operations
description:
Job Requisition ID #
26WD101479
Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced, highly organized, and collaborative Principal Program Manager, Business Operations to join the LEEP Office of the Chief of Staff. This role is responsible for the operational execution, program coordination, tracking, and reporting that helps LEEP run effectively.
LEEP sits at the intersection of technology and the business, building and enhancing systems and tools that enable teams across Autodesk, including Sales, Finance, Marketing, and others, to succeed.
The Office of the Chief of Staff establishes the operating framework that helps LEEP work effectively as one organization. This role helps shape, evolve, operationalize and ultimately supports that framework by managing the processes, tools, data, and recurring activities required to keep the organization organized and on track.
You will be responsible for maintaining, the governance rhythm, visibility across key programs and operational activities, coordinating inputs and deliverables across teams, tracking commitments and milestones, preparing reporting, and ensuring timely follow-through. You will also manage several recurring business operations processes, including budget coordination, contractor operations, organizational reporting, meeting cadences, and other cross-functional activities. This position offers flexibility, allowing for on-site, hybrid, or remote work in the United States or Canada, with up to 20% travel to Autodesk office locations and Autodesk-sponsored events.
Responsibilities
Business Operations & Reporting:
Manage recurring business operations processes and operating cadences across LEEP
Maintain dashboards, trackers, calendars, and reporting that provide clear visibility into key activities, milestones, commitments, risks, and dependencies
Gather and consolidate inputs from teams to produce accurate, timely status reporting for the Chief of Staff
Track key operational metrics and activities across areas such as budget, hiring, contractor workforce, enablement, employee engagement, and roadmap milestones
Maintain operational documentation, process guides, templates, and other resources that enable consistent execution
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, or automate recurring operational processes
Program Management & Tracking:
Maintain plans, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, and action items for key programs and operational initiatives
Track commitments and deliverables and proactively follow up with owners to ensure timely completion
Coordinate status updates across multiple teams and workstreams and surface risks, delays, or dependencies requiring attention
Establish practical tracking and reporting mechanisms for new programs or activities where needed
Maintain action and decision logs and ensure agreed-upon next steps are captured and followed through
Support program owners with planning, coordination, documentation, and reporting
Cross-Functional Operations:
Coordinate operational activities and deliverables across Finance, HR, Vendor Management, Sourcing, Enablement, and other partner functions
Track and manage statements of work, contractor onboarding and offboarding processes, tracking requests, approvals, access, and completion of required activities
Coordinate budget-related activities with Finance
Support hiring and workforce tracking by maintaining current information and coordinating required inputs with relevant partners
Track cross-functional requests and dependencies to ensure they reach the appropriate owners and are completed on time
Meetings & Organizational Support:
Coordinate recurring operating reviews, team forums, workshops, and offsites
Prepare agendas, materials, data, and status updates needed for effective meetings
Facilitate operational and program reviews as needed, with a focus on progress, risks, decisions, and actions
Document decisions, actions, owners, and deadlines and manage follow-up through completion
Provide operational support for Communities of Practice, including scheduling, communications, materials, and action tracking
Support employee engagement activities through planning, coordination, communications, logistics, and tracking
Minimum Qualifications
7+ years of experience in business operations, program management, technical program management, or a related discipline within a high-tech or similarly complex organization
Demonstrated experience managing operational processes and multiple concurrent workstreams
Strong program management skills, including planning, milestone tracking, dependency management, risk identification, action tracking, and follow-through
Strong analytical skills with experience building and maintaining dashboards, reports, trackers, and operational metrics
Experience supporting business processes such as budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, hiring, vendor or contractor management, and organizational reporting
Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with a demonstrated ability to keep complex activities and multiple stakeholders on track
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to consolidate information from multiple sources into clear, concise updates
Strong relationship-building and coordination skills with the ability to work effectively across teams and functions
Ability to identify issues, escalate appropriately, and drive operational items through resolution
Ability to prioritize and execute across multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment
A continuous-improvement mindset and demonstrated ability to make recurring processes simpler, more consistent, and more efficient.
High proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Copilot. Familiarity with tools such as Airtable and Jira is preferred
The Ideal Candidate
This is a hands-on operations role for someone who is exceptionally strong at bringing structure to complex and ambiguous environments, designing scalable approaches, where established processes do not exist. You are comfortable managing multiple workstreams, working with data, creating clear and useful reporting, coordinating across functions, and ensuring that details do not fall through the cracks. Success in this role means that LEEP’s operational processes run smoothly, leaders have accurate and timely information, teams understand what is expected of them, and commitments are consistently tracked through completion.
What a day in the life could look like: You might start the morning reviewing program trackers and upcoming milestones, following up on overdue actions, and gathering status updates for an upcoming business review.
Next, you could work with Finance to reconcile budget information, coordinate with HR on hiring data, or move a contractor onboarding request through the required process.
Later, you might prepare materials for a leadership meeting, consolidate updates from several teams into a concise status report, or document decisions, owners, and due dates in a meeting.
In the afternoon, you could update an operational dashboard, coordinate logistics for an upcoming team forum, support a Community of Practice, document a recurring process, or identify a way to simplify a manual workflow.
Across these activities, your role is to create structure, maintain visibility, coordinate execution, and ensure follow-through.
