title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.


 


You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.


 


Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.


 


How it works


 




Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.


Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.


Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.


Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.


Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.


Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.


Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.




 


Requirements


 




2+ years of professional software engineering


Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)


Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++


Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing


Regular use of an AI coding tool


Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models


You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words


At least 10 hours a week, starting now


A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)




 


Nice to have


 




Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure


Experience building agent tasks or RL environments




 


Terms


 




US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you


Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms


The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us


Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork




 


Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

Attraktive Vergütung

Regelmäßige Team- und Networking-Events

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Your Opportunity
As a 
Principal Engineer
, you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs. 
 
You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.
Primary Responsibilities
Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services
Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations
Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling
Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications
Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers
Implement and maintain API security patterns including OAuth 2.0, scope-based authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging for compliant clinical data access
Design and optimize real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding CDS Hooks and APIsâensuring low latency, high freshness, and graceful failure modes
Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs â including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems
Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements
Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence
Exercise architectural judgment across tradeoffs in correctness, latency, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk in clinical data systems
Design and implement reliability patterns for CDS and API services including monitoring, alerting, failure detection, graceful degradation, and incident recovery
Partner with Data Reliability Engineer to define and operate SLAs for CDS Hook delivery, API response times, and data freshness aligned to clinical needs
Establish and uphold engineering standards for API design, data schemas, integration patterns, and interoperability; maintain high-quality technical documentation and OpenAPI specifications
Partner with Data Engineering to align upstream data models, gold-layer datasets, and platform capabilities with clinical decision support and API requirements
Serve as the technical authority on clinical interoperability standards (SMART CDS Hooks, FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, EHR integration patterns)
Collaborate with Product, Clinical Operations, and Business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate clinical workflows into platform features, and shape product direction
Act as trusted technical advisor to EMR partners, healthcare systems, and external API consumers; ensure expectations and delivery are well-defined and predictable
Ensure all CDS and API services comply with healthcare security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, state regulations, payer mandates)
Partner with IT Security and Compliance teams to implement secure access controls, audit logging, encryption, and data protection measures across delivery mechanisms
Design and implement audit trails for all clinical data access; support compliance audits and regulatory reporting
Mentor team members through design reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance on clinical data integration and API design
Document new and existing systems, designs, processes, and procedures
Required Qualifications
8+ years of experience designing, building, and operating API platforms, service-oriented systems, or backend infrastructure at scale
Demonstrated experience operating at a senior or staff-level individual contributor scope, owning complex systems end-to-end
3+ years of direct experience with healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, clinical data exchange, or healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7, CDA, claims data)
2+ years of hands-on experience with CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR, or similar clinical decision support APIs
Strong experience designing and operating REST APIs, including contract design, versioning, error handling, and authentication/authorization patterns
Deep understanding of healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, and interoperability patterns (FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR)
Expertise in designing for reliability, SLAs, and operational metrics; ability to translate clinical requirements into technical SLOs
Experience defining and measuring API performance metrics (latency, availability, error rates); familiarity with SLA monitoring and enforcement
Strong systems thinking with ability to design for scale, reliability, maintainability, and resilience
Proficiency in modern backend languages (Python, Java, Go, or similar); comfort reading and reviewing code across languages
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Databricks, GCP) and containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed services)
Proven ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, analytics, clinical operations, and business teams
Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly for explaining technical concepts and tradeoffs to clinicians and non-specialists
Comfortable working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with healthcare compliance and regulatory constraints
Strong Pluses
Hands-on experience with CDS Hooks specification and SMART on FHIR implementations in production healthcare environments
Experience implementing and testing CDS Hooks across multiple EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) including clinical workflow validation
Familiarity with healthcare data formats and standards: FHIR resources (Patient, Condition, Medication, etc.), CCD/C-CDA, claims data (837s, 835s), HL7 v2 or v3
Experience designing and operating real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding clinical applications and decision support systems
Knowledge of value-based care metrics, care gaps, quality measures (NQF, HEDIS), and HCC/RAF risk stratification
Experience with API management platforms, developer portals, or partner ecosystem / API monetization patterns
Familiarity with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and federated identity patterns in healthcare systems
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and safe deployment practices
Background supporting provider-facing platforms or external clinical partners; deep understanding of provider workflows and constraints
Experience in a healthcare startup or high-growth healthcare technology environment
Familiarity with healthcare data governance, interoperability regulations (21st Century Cures, ONC rules), and clinical data quality frameworks
Experience with API testing frameworks and quality assurance for distributed systems

title: Backend Engineer (Ruby), Create: Change Record
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

We are looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Change Record team within GitLab’s Source Code stage. As AI agents increasingly write code alongside people, every change needs a clear, trustworthy record of what changed, why, and who or what made it. You’ll build that record into GitLab’s source code experience, for humans and agents alike. This is a backend-focused role for an engineer with full-stack experience who enjoys balancing work on existing systems with new product development.

That work happens in one of GitLab’s oldest and most complex product areas, where you’ll use Ruby on Rails to improve a critical system serving GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. Source Code provides the interface layer, through Gitaly, to the Git repositories behind a large share of GitLab traffic, so you’ll help keep it reliable through performance tuning, caching, rate limiting, observability, and resiliency, collaborating with product, design, security, Gitaly, Code Review, and Source Code Experience teams. Supporting production systems and improving established experiences are central to the role, especially while you’re onboarding, and over time you’ll also help build experiences for developers working with agents.

You'll work remotely from the United Kingdom or Poland.

What you’ll do

  • Develop secure, well-tested, performant features and improvements using Ruby on Rails and GraphQL, among other technologies.
  • Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system.
  • Design and maintain backend services, APIs, data models, and business logic that support intuitive source code workflows.
  • Collaborate across functions and teams, both asynchronously and synchronously, and involve domain experts when their input will improve the outcome.
  • Use AI agents for well-scoped work when they can speed up delivery without sacrificing quality, and critically review their output.
  • Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews.
  • Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency.
  • Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others.

What you’ll bring

  • Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL.
  • An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices.
  • Experience with full-stack development to build and maintain user-facing workflows and their underlying systems.
  • Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes.
  • Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment.
  • The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed.
  • Experience using AI coding agents to speed up software development while critically reviewing their output.
  • Bonus: you’ve built agents or agent-based workflows that run in production, not just prototypes.

About the team

The functional team works across Europe and North America, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous collaboration. It includes four engineers, comprising both backend and frontend engineers. We work closely with other Source Code teams, Agentic Preview, Repository Services, and Hardening, as well as other teams in the company such as the Gitaly team, and the AI Governance team.

 

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the EU, applicable in the specified country or countries only. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location and having regard to any applicable collective agreements. The base salary range does not include bonuses, equity, or benefits.

title: Operatore esperto addetto al taglio
description:
Stiamo cercando un/una operatore/trice esperto/a addetto al taglio che entri a far parte del nostro team di produzione a Cadorago, in Italia. L'operatore lavora in piena autonomia, senza la necessità di una particolare supervisione. Adatta con successo procedure, utensili e attrezzature per soddisfare i requisiti di produzione, assumendo il ruolo di operatore principale sulle macchine da taglio (slitter) e sulla linea di imballaggio. In questa mansione, ha la completa responsabilità del setup delle macchine, dell'ottimizzazione della velocità e dell'esecuzione del piano di produzione rispetto agli obiettivi previsti.
In sede
Eseguire il setup completo delle macchine da taglio (slitter) e della linea di imballaggio, ottimizzandone la velocità in base al piano di produzione.
Svolgere la manutenzione autonoma di 1° livello (TPM) per garantire l'affidabilità dei macchinari e la stabilità del processo.
Rispettare rigorosamente le linee guida EHS (Salute, Sicurezza e Ambiente), le procedure operative standard (SOP) e gli standard 5S.
Condurre in totale sicurezza le attrezzature per la movimentazione delle merci, tra cui carrelli elevatori, transpallet manuali e carrelli retrattili.
Partecipare al sistema di lavoro collaborativo, fungendo da esempio comportamentale per l'intero team attraverso un'elevata consapevolezza e orientamento al miglioramento continuo.

Requisiti:
Diploma di scuola secondaria di secondo grado o titolo equivalente, con almeno 5 anni di comprovata esperienza in ambito produttivo o manifatturiero.
Buona padronanza nell'utilizzo di software e sistemi gestionali per la produzione, unita a un livello di inglese comunicativo/operativo.
Costituisce un forte vantaggio una precedente esperienza lavorativa diretta su macchine da taglio/taglierine, linee di imballaggio, nel settore della stampa o in contesti manifatturieri ad alto contenuto tecnologico
Il possesso del patentino per il muletto sarà considerato un plus.
Competenze necessarie per avere successo:
Eccellente attitudine a lavorare in ambienti dinamici e veloci, dimostrando buone capacità di problem solving logico e un'attitudine matematica e meccanico/tecnica.
Ottime doti interpersonali, di comunicazione e di lavoro in squadra, con la capacità di operare in autonomia, in sicurezza e nel rispetto delle tempistiche.

Cosa Offriamo 
Ecco una panoramica dei principali vantaggi e opportunità che ti aspettano:
- 
Sicurezza e Assistenza Sanitaria Completa
: *Assicurazione Sanitaria: Copertura sanitaria (con inclusione parziale dell'assistenza odontoiatrica). *Assicurazione Vita e Infortuni: Copertura per infortuni sul lavoro e nella vita privata (professionali ed extra-professionali). - Proteggi il Tuo Futuro: Piano pensionistico con contributi aziendali aggiuntivi versati a Fon.te (fondo di riferimento nel settore).
- 
Equilibrio Vita-Lavoro e Flessibilità
: *Orario Flessibile: Orario settimanale ordinario di 38,5 ore. *Congedo Parentale: Pienamente conforme alle leggi locali.
-
 Benessere e Supporto
: *Programma di Assistenza ai Dipendenti: Programma LYRA per supporto emotivo e psicologico. *Osteopata in Sede: Disponibilità di un osteopata in sede (1 volta al mese).
- 
Sviluppo Continuo e Vantaggi in Sede
: *Buoni Pasto (del valore netto di 7€ per giorno lavorato di almeno 4 ore). *Piani di sviluppo individuali. 
Offriamo, inoltre, le seguenti opportunità formative:
Corso di Primo Soccorso e Antincendio
Formazione EHS (Salute, Sicurezza e Ambiente)
Formazione per la conduzione di carrelli elevatori o macchine per la movimentazione
Formazione sull'uso di transpallet manuali e carrelli retrattili
Formazione su YC, BC e processi di escalation
Formazione sul metodo 5S
Formazione sulle procedure operative standard (SOP)
Formazione su Magma
Utilizzo e compilazione STA
Corso per Front Line Leader (opzionale)
Formazione abilitante per lavori in quota su piattaforme (opzionale)
Per aiutarci a elaborare rapidamente la tua candidatura, ti preghiamo di caricare il tuo CV in formato PDF o Word. Ti chiediamo inoltre gentilmente di inviare il tuo curriculum nella stessa lingua di questo annuncio di lavoro.
Perché entrare in Avery Dennison
Siamo un'azienda globale specializzata nella scienza dei materiali e nelle soluzioni di identificazione digitale con sedi in oltre 50 paesi e circa 35.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo. Come azienda orientata alla scienza e all'innovazione, crediamo che i team diversificati siano i più forti. Ci impegniamo a promuovere una cultura basata sulla curiosità e sul coraggio, dove puoi far crescere la tua carriera all'interno di un'azienda che ha l'innovazione nel proprio DNA. Fondati sull'idea di creare un impatto reale per garantire un futuro migliore, ci impegniamo a offrire un ambiente di lavoro aperto e collaborativo in cui la diversità di pensiero è incoraggiata e rispettata. Scopri cosa pensano i nostri dipendenti dell'esperienza di lavoro in Avery Dennison. Maggiori informazioni su
 www.averydennison.com
. In Avery Dennison, collaboriamo con i più grandi marchi nei settori FMCG (Beni di consumo in rapido movimento), Abbigliamento, Automotive e Farmaceutico. Il nostro Centro di Distribuzione di Cadorago, fondato nel 1964, offre un ambiente collaborativo e dinamico che supporta le nostre divisioni LPM e Graphics e impiega circa 87 professionisti di talento. Le funzioni chiave in questa sede includono le Operations,Vendite e il Servizio Clienti, offrendo percorsi di carriera diversificati e opportunità di crescita.

La fascia di retribuzione base indicata sopra rappresenta ciò che Avery Dennison prevede ragionevolmente di pagare per questa posizione alla data di pubblicazione.  Partner with teams to reduce waste, elevate first-pass ISO 9000 quality yields, and build out line-level change agent development paths for floor leadership and drive continuous improvement.

 Deliver against overall site OGSM framework (objectives,goals, strategies and measures)—achieving throughput milestones, operational cost targets, and capital project implementation deadlines.

As a Process Engineer at Avery Dennison, you will play a critical role supporting day-to-day manufacturing operations and driving continuous improvement for coating and compounding assets within a 24/7 manufacturing environment. Acting as an essential technical partner to site leadership, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including Operations, Marketing, and R&D—to optimize product performance, execute capital projects, and deliver sustainable improvements in safety, quality, productivity, and cost.

Identify, investigate, and analyze production issues using Six Sigma methodologies, statistical process controls (SPC), and structured root-cause problem solving to eliminate losses and continuously enhance coating line productivity and quality.
Continually improve and optimize current product lines and manufacturing processes by reducing variation, executing line trials, and conducting thorough process capability studies.
Partner cross-functionally with Marketing and R&D teams to support new product development, raw material qualifications, and production scale-ups across manufacturing assets.
Initiate, scope, manage, and execute capital engineering projects and site continuous improvement initiatives, implementing new equipment, establishing long-term sustainment control strategies, and developing technical training to mentor operations personnel.

Strong technical working knowledge of process optimization and continuous manufacturing operations, with hands-on experience in web handling, pressure-sensitive adhesive (PSA) coating, compounding, or 24/7 operational environments highly preferred.

title: Transaction Review Lead
description:

As Transaction Review Lead, you’ll own bunq’s line against money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions evasion, across both Transaction Filtering Review and Transaction Monitoring Review. You’ll bring them together into one team, with 5 direct reports.
Take Ownership: 
Simplifying from user’s Perspective:
 Redesign every Transaction Review process starting from what’s best for the user, as part of our zero-based Future of FinCrime redesign.
AI Where It Counts:
 Establish the real volumes first, then use AI and in-house models only where they make things faster or better for Eva, not automation for its own sake.
Risk Ownership:
 Own the quarterly risk assessment across both domains and close CAP items before they turn into compliance breaches.
One Team, One Rhythm:
 Unite TFR and TMR behind the same KPIs (CSAT, UE, Total Handle Time, Compliance breaches) with a clear weekly cadence, owners, and fast escalation of blockers.
Decisions That Hold Up:
 Make sure the rationale behind every investigation decision is documented to a standard that would survive a regulator’s review.
Coaching & Accountability:
 Give your team direct, constructive feedback and hold everyone accountable for delivering.

Requirements:

title: Deputy AML Manager - Belgium
description:

At bunq, we're more than just a bank, we're transforming how people experience banking across Europe. Our users deserve to bank like locals, no matter where they are. We started Belgium with local IBANs, but we're now upgrading to full-branch status, which means taking on direct regulatory standing, deeper compliance obligations, and new accountability to Belgium's NBB (National Bank of Belgium) and financial regulators.
As AML Manager Belgium, your mission is to lead Belgium through this compliance transition, ensuring we move seamlessly from our lighter vIBAN model to full-branch operations while maintaining regulatory trust and operational excellence. You'll be the accountable person who owns Belgium's entire compliance footprint, AML/CFT operational readiness, integrity-risk assessment (SIRA), and financial-crime reporting (FIU), all operating at full-branch regulatory standards.
Take Ownership
As AML Belgium, you'll own:
Transition Belgium to full-branch compliance model, migrate from vIBAN-era compliance systems to full-branch operations, ensuring seamless readiness for NBB oversight and maintaining zero regulatory findings during the upgrade.
Own Belgium's SIRA, AML/CFT, and FIU obligations end-to-end, establish Belgium-localized SIRA integrity-risk assessments, AML/CFT gap analysis, and FIU financial-crime reporting, using AI-first mechanisms to deliver what traditional banks staff with a local team.
Prepare Belgium's AML program for regulatory inspection readiness, maintain audit trails, evidence documentation, and control testing for NBB oversight.

Full-Branch Compliance Readiness Audit : Conduct a comprehensive audit of Belgium's current compliance posture under vIBAN model, identify gaps for full-branch requirements (NBB, FSMA, Ombudsfin), and deliver a remediation roadmap with specific AI-driven solutions.

Requirements:
Do You Have What It Takes?
Deep Belgian AML/CFT & regulatory expertise - You understand NBB requirements, FSMA rules, local banking regulations, and their practical application; you can translate Belgian regulatory language into operational compliance controls.
Proven ownership of compliance programs end-to-end - You've built or scaled a compliance program (not just supported one), managing operational readiness, risk assessment, and regulatory reporting as the accountable person.
Proven ability to manage AML inspections and regulatory audits, preparing evidence, audit trails, and control documentation for regulator scrutiny.
AI-first operating mindset - You're comfortable building compliance operations using AI and automation (not traditional local headcount), and you can design mechanisms that let AI handle routine workflows while you focus on exceptions and regulatory judgment.
Fluency in Dutch, French, or both + English - You can navigate Belgian regulatory communication and engage with local stakeholders in their language; English fluency for bunq-wide collaboration.
